asr.full_text: This is Shahndog just respective structure exactly the way we mapped it. In the last update, I clearly said once it loses the 0.10 support direction shifts to the down side and the next magnet sits around the 0.090 region. The market did not hesitate after breaking 0.10 price continued bleeding and tapped 0.091 almost perfectly into that projected zone. This is what clean breakdown continuation looks like. When a strong psychological level like 0.10 gets lost, it usually does not recover immediately. Instead, it searches for the next liquidity pocket and in this case that pocket was sitting around .090, now the market is trading around 0.092. Now the market is trading around 0.02 hovering just above that short term support. This is a very important decision area if 0.090 holds and we start seeing stabilization with stronger candle closes and reduced selling pressure. Then a relief bounce towards 0.10 is very possible. That would be a classic retest of the previously broken support. Remember, once support breaks, it tends to flip into resistance, so even if price bounces, 0.10 becomes the key barrier overhead. However, if 0.090 fails to hold and we see strong bearish candles closing below it, then the next downside target opens for 0.080. That is the original higher time support where DOGE previously based before pushing upwards that zone carries more structural weight compared to the current minor support. From a broader perspective, DOGE is still printing lower highs and lowers lows after losing 0.10. That keeps the short-term trend bearish. Any upside move for now would be considered a corrective bounce unless price reclaims and holds above 0.10 with strength. Also keep in mind that meme coins tend to exaggerate moves. When momentum builds, they drop fast and bounce fast. so reaction at 0.090 will likely be sharp in either direction. Watch volume behavior carefully. Weak bounces with low convection usually get sold into. So the road map is simple. Holding 0.090 can trigger a retest towards 0.10. Losing 0.090 increases probability of continuation towards 0.080 where the stronger base sits. Structure first, Emotions last, Market already respected the downside call once. Let the levels guide next moves.
